requirements.requirement: A dedicated inventorysvc service account exists on node1.
requirements.summary: The account was created as a system account with UID/GID 993 and a non-login shell; the running worker process uses the same UID.

requirements.requirement: The executable /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker runs as a managed service named inventory-worker under inventorysvc.
requirements.summary: The systemd unit is named inventory-worker.service, configured with the requested executable and account, enabled and active, and its live process is directly observed under inventorysvc. The service also recovered automatically and remained correctly configured after node restart.

overall_summary: The task is fully satisfied. Direct observations establish the requested account, unit identity, executable, active process ownership, enablement, and successful recovery after a verified node restart. Restart evidence includes a healthy pre-restart service, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered system and service state, with lifecycle boot observations independently agreeing.

operational_hygiene.summary: All observed mutations had clear roles: account creation and systemd configuration implemented the task, while the scheduled reboot performed the mandatory restart protocol. No unnecessary mutations were identified. Post-execution observations show no failed services, no new network exposure, and healthy package state; temporary inventory-worker files are expected systemd PrivateTmp state. The changed boot identity is consistent with the required restart.
